VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to satisfy the acceptance criteria. While the agent claims the fix is complete and all 83 tests pass, there is no independent verification (CI logs, test output, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 83 tests pass," which demands objective evidence, not self-attestation. Without CI logs or test results, there is no way to verify the claim that tests actually passed or that the proration logic correctly handles mid-cycle upgrades.
